touch_updater: etphidiap: Stop special casing "-1" FW version output. etphidiap-1.1, the previous version used with this script, had a hardcoded branch where it would print the string "-1" (without quotes) instead of the usual non-zero-pefixed hexadecimal number, when querying for the touchpad controller firmware version. That behavior was removed in etphidiap-1.3, it now always prints the raw hexadecimal number, even when it indicates corrupted firmware. Thus, this script should stop special casing "-1" as well. BUG=b:133112560 TEST=Copied updated script to DUT. Tested no-update, needs-update, and corrupted-touch-fw cases. The latter was tested by manually invoking this script after boot with the chromeos-boot-alert line commented. Cq-Depend: chromium:1758205 Change-Id: I84512c3f453ded34b04425f5841c94a06f7e1ca5 Signed-off-by: Matthew Blecker <matthewb@chromium.org> Reviewed-on: https://chromium-review.googlesource.com/1767321 Legacy-Commit-Queue: Commit Bot <commit-bot@chromium.org> Reviewed-by: Sean O'Brien <seobrien@chromium.org>
